text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I could barely cling on at all. It was like
there
wasn't so much as a breath of wind
in my sails...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have only my inadequate skill to blame.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have only my inadequate skill to blame.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Next time I'm on the track, I'll
whip up a
wind—no, I'll stir up a storm!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'll be putting more effort than
ever into my
training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Together... Yes. We'll both become
stronger
together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And then, we will seize the winds of

victory—together.
